This code system https://fhir.inera.se/CodeSystem/dispenseauthorizationstatus defines the following codes:

CodeDefinition
ATTACHED Be om endast kopplade (ATTACHED) expedieringsunderlag.
NOT_ATTACHED Be om endast okopplade (NOT_ATTACHED) expedieringsunderlag.
ALL Be om både kopplade och okopplade.
